title: Skills bundle: install, discovery, invocation, and clean uninstall
prerequisites: Node.js >= 18 and the make-docs CLI built from this repository.
A fresh disposable fixture workspace; the scenario never touches a maintainer working tree.
Command steps below are rendered for the Codex first-pass target binding; projecting them for another bound target is owned by kit generation (PRD 43 R-KIT-1), never by hand-editing this definition.

steps.notes: Disposable fixture workspace (workspacePolicy); all later steps run inside it.

Installs Make Docs into the disposable workspace: `package write` refuses installed outputs without a Make Docs manifest, and the uninstall stage's `setup remove` presupposes a real install to remove (register item D-023: precondition establishment is a workspace-setup step, never remembered mid-session; this missing step was surfaced by the W18 R13 P2 kit generator's executable-by-construction dry-run).
The v2-form source Playbook enters the workspace as ordinary project content.

steps.run:
mkdir -p "$WORKSPACE/.make-docs" && printf 'packaging:
  preconditions:
    harness-supported: satisfied
    project-trusted: satisfied
    symlink-or-copy-mirror: satisfied
' > "$WORKSPACE/.make-docs/config.yaml"
steps.notes: Establishes the packaging precondition attestations the ship step consumes (register item D-023: attestations are supplied by the session's workspace setup, never remembered mid-session; the operator attests the disposable workspace is trusted and the adapter preconditions hold).

steps.run: cd "$WORKSPACE" && make-docs run package ship --harness codex --output-kind skills-bundle --surface native --scope project --package-id conformance-skill-probe --support-evidence-ref conformance/tuple-registry.json#codex-skills-bundle-native-project --json agent/conformance-skill-probe
steps.notes: Run once per targeted tuple: --surface native with the codex-skills-bundle-native-project evidence ref, and --surface agents-standard with the codex-skills-bundle-agents-standard-project evidence ref. The evidence ref names the exact registry tuple this session's evidence lands on (D-023: the planner hard-stops without one). `ship` runs plan -> preview -> write end-to-end (PRD 41 grammar; --write is retired).

steps.assert: The ship transcript's generated-output records list the bundle files under .agents/skills/conformance-skill-probe/ and the workspace manifest records Make Docs ownership for every generated file.

steps.action: Launch the target harness inside the workspace and enumerate the harness's own skills listing surface; confirm conformance-skill-probe appears in the harness's listing, not merely on disk.
In a fresh harness thread, invoke the conformance-skill-probe skill and capture the transcript.

steps.assert: The invocation transcript contains the probe marker MAKE-DOCS-CONFORMANCE-SKILL-PROBE-OK emitted by the bundled skill.

steps.notes: --yes carries the uninstall confirmation for the non-TTY run (D-023: the TTY confirmation gate refuses a non-TTY run without it).

steps.assert: After removal the generated bundle files and their exposure links are gone, no empty managed directory is orphaned under .agents/skills/, and every user-authored workspace file survives byte-identical.

expectedEvidence: A --json ship transcript recording the generated bundle files and ownership records (install).
The bundle listed by the target harness's own listing surface (discover).
A fresh-thread invocation transcript containing MAKE-DOCS-CONFORMANCE-SKILL-PROBE-OK (invoke).
A non-TTY removal transcript plus a workspace diff proving clean uninstall with user files intact (uninstall).
Model, provider, and runtime captured as run metadata in the result record, never embedded in scenario logic.

install: make-docs run package ship exits 0 and its --json transcript records the generated bundle files and manifest ownership inside the disposable workspace.
discover: The generated bundle appears in the target harness's own skills listing surface for the workspace — harness listing output, not Make Docs output.
invoke: A fresh harness thread invokes the bundled skill and the transcript contains the probe marker MAKE-DOCS-CONFORMANCE-SKILL-PROBE-OK.
uninstall: After make-docs setup remove --backup --yes, managed generated outputs are removed, no empty managed directory is orphaned, and user-authored files survive byte-identical.

preconditions.description: The target harness CLI is installed and on PATH; the concrete probe command lives on each target binding.
The target harness CLI is signed in with a working account; the concrete probe command lives on each target binding.
Outbound network access for the harness is available; attested by the operator at run time because probing it would spend it.
The harness can route to a model for the invoke stage; attested by the operator at run time.
